sources.text: SKYPACK Create attractive packages that stand out the contents. SKYPACK Packaging Co., Ltd manufactures jewelry cases, watch cases, pen cases, cosmetic cases, metal products, wooden boxes, etc... We are a comprehensive package company. Package production matched to customer requirements. Detailed response from luxury goods to mass production. It is possible to Product packages, sundries and accessories using various materials such as plastic, paper, glass, synthetic leather and wood. Please feel free to contact us. 10 reasons to choose Skypack 1 Quality We produce products that conform to quality standards mainly in Japan and around the world. With a commitment to quality, we also carry out inspections in our factory. 2 Speedy We will proceed from sample preparation to production, inspection and delivery in a short delivery time. We have achieved a significant reduction in lead time by constantly stocking frequently used materials and rigorous process control. 3 Aftercare We also support aftercare after delivery. Exchange and repair are also available. 4 Japanese management SKYPACK is Japanese-owned. We are safe, secure and polite. We have earned the trust of many customers 5 Own factory It is manufactured at the China factory (Huizhou, Guangdong), which is wholly owned by the Japanese president. We educate each employee firmly in order to stably supply high-quality products, and operate the plant. 6 Artisans We are carefully producted by SKYPACK exclusive craftsmen. They have the skills to handle complex products that require high technology. 7 Composite products It is possible to create a product design that combines various materials such as plastic, leather, glass, paper, etc. that require high skill. It is our original skill which can not imitate in other companies. 8 Network Based on years of experience, we have built a wide network in Japan, China and Hong Kong. Our alliances with material makers and parts makers around the world create an environment that can meet the diverse needs of our customers. 9 Molding machines, 3D printers, other machinesy The latest Molding Machines, 3D Printers, Silk Printing Machines, Sonic Sealing Machines, etc. are introduced to enable production with high quality and quick delivery. 10 Materials We have high quality materials from material companies around the world through our own network.
